create_AlphaZeroEvaluator: create an AlphaZeroEvaluator instance with a pyspiel game, neural network model, and optional cache size
run_AlphaZeroEvaluator_evaluate: run the evaluate method to return value predictions for both players from a game state
run_AlphaZeroEvaluator_prior: run the prior method to return action probabilities for all legal actions in a game state
run_AlphaZeroEvaluator_cache_info: run the cache_info method to retrieve LRU cache statistics including size and hit rate
run_AlphaZeroEvaluator_clear_cache: run the clear_cache method to clear JAX compilation caches and the evaluator LRU cache
